viewport_notes: a policy / legal / info page (refund, shipping, privacy, terms, about). Plain but readable + real content.

checks.rule: no Liquid/render errors, no empty shell, no Lorem/placeholder/[CLAIM] text — real policy content is present
the page has substantive policy copy, not a one-line stub or default boilerplate left unedited
comfortable line length + clear headings/sections; not edge-to-edge unbroken text
no overflow/overlap; consistent chrome; hierarchy intact (H1 page title)
